rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Fetches live documentation directly from source at query time, bypassing stale training data. Covers 363+ libraries across Python, Go, Rust, and web standards including OWASP, MDN, and WebAssembly. Includes a code audit tool that scans source files at file-and-line level against 100+ patterns sourced from OWASP cheat sheets, typescript-eslint rules, and framework-specific best practices, fetching current fix guidance from authoritative sources.
